about: Lake Country is a district municipality in British Columbia’s Okanagan Valley north of Kelowna, encompassing communities around Wood Lake, Kalamalka Lake’s north end, and Okanagan Lake shores—not a single downtown city. Wineries, beaches, and orchard country sit among Winfield, Oyama, and Carr’s Landing. About 15,000 people live in Lake Country.
